body:
## What it does

Point it at the places your business already keeps its numbers and history, and it becomes the thing people ask first. Back comes a quick picture of where things stand, a single settled answer to questions that keep coming round, and your own position laid beside a competitor's when you need the gap stated plainly. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @SaaSocalypse shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
